title: About Ayurveda
text: Ayurveda is a traditional Indian system of medicine. Evidence for specific treatments varies; traditional use does not establish that a product treats or cures a disease.

title: Herbal product safety
text: Natural does not automatically mean safe. Some Ayurvedic preparations may contain toxic metals. Check ingredients and product quality, and discuss herbal supplements with a qualified healthcare professional.

title: Using Ayurveda alongside healthcare
text: Do not use Ayurvedic products to postpone medical care or replace prescribed treatment. This assistant provides general information and catalog facts, not diagnosis or personalized treatment.

title: Nuts and allergens
text: Tree nuts such as almonds, walnuts and cashews can cause allergic reactions. Check the ingredient and allergen information on each package; do not assume a product is safe because it is natural.

title: Checking dry-fruit labels
text: Check the package label for ingredients and allergens before choosing dried fruits or mixed nuts. Product-specific additives and cross-contact information must come from the actual label, not assumptions.
